title: The Great Divide
notes:
First Pressing CD:
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37175151-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide-]US[/url] & [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37170543-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide-]EU[/url] standard
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37164279-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]US Target exclusive[/url] / [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37222458]EU retailer exclusive[/url] with Live Bonus Tracks

In the US, [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37183041]copies sold separately on the artist webstore[/url] were packaged and sold with a signed insert.
 
First Pressing Vinyl:
- American Rust, [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37156125-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]US[/url] & [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37161246-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]EU[/url] standard
- Headlights In The Dark, [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37260279-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]US[/url] & [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37161384-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]EU[/url] webstore exclusive
- Porch Light, [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37163916-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]US[/url] & [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37221225]EU[/url] webstore exclusive
- Cigarette Smoke, [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37201086-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]US[/url] & [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37168179-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]EU[/url] webstore exclusive
- Podunk Translucent, [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37182936-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]US[/url] & [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37172583-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]EU[/url] Spotify Fans First exclusive
- Morning Fog Translucent, [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37173399-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]US Target exclusive[/url] / [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37161528-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]EU various retailer exclusive[/url]
- Beer Bottle Translucent, [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37155918-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]US[/url] & [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37157979-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]EU[/url] indie retail exclusive

In the US, [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37169415-Noah-Kahan-The-Great-Divide]copies sold separately of the American Rust vinyl[/url] were packaged and sold with signed inserts.

In the US, copies of the Cigarette Smoke vinyl variant were sold on April 29th, 2026 at Grimey’s Music in Nashville, TN to be autographed during a meet-and-greet event. Copies signed during this event were signed by Noah on the cover in black, silver, and bronze sharpie.
